headline: New U.S. Tariffs on Processed Goods Hit Nigerian Small-Business Exporters
summary: Trade Pathways has begun coverage on Nigeria as newly imposed United States tariffs fall hardest on processed goods, which represent the core of Nigeria's small-business export sector.
why: Tariff adjustments by major trading partners alter export margins and trade balances for emerging markets pursuing industrialization.

impacts.name: Export Manufacturing
impacts.why: Import taxes reduce the price competitiveness and sales volumes of Nigerian manufactured exports in the US.
